request.text: A delightful 2.6 second cartoon game reward: immediate warm fireplace WHOOF with soft woody crackle and rounded bass pop, then after 0.8 seconds a bright rising wooden marimba and plucked bell flourish landing in a happy major chord with tiny golden sparkles. Tactile, bouncy, cozy and satisfying, matching a friendly educational adventure. Clean isolated sound, no speech, no music bed, no harsh explosion, no alarm, no long ambience.
